purpose.en: Practice a controlled standing side bend to lengthen one side of the waist.

text.zh: 右手举过头，身体慢慢向左侧弯，不前倾
text.en: Reach your right arm overhead and bend slowly to the left without leaning forwards

text.zh: 双脚稳定承重，骨盆保持在双脚上方
text.en: Keep both feet planted with the pelvis centred over them.

text.zh: 侧弯保持舒适范围，继续呼吸，不追求深度
text.en: Bend only through a comfortable range and keep breathing rather than forcing depth.

text.zh: 慢慢回到直立，完成当前侧剂量后再提示换侧
text.en: Return slowly upright and finish the current side dose before cueing a side change.

commonErrors.zh: 变成前屈或旋转，骨盆明显侧移
commonErrors.en: Bending forwards or twisting while shifting the pelvis sideways.

commonErrors.zh: 耸肩、憋气或用弹振强压侧弯
commonErrors.en: Shrugging, holding the breath or bouncing into the side bend.

items.zh: 肩与颈：右臂过头以舒适为限，不耸肩挤压颈部。
items.en: Shoulders and neck: keep the right arm overhead comfortably without shrugging into the neck.

items.zh: 腰侧与平衡：双脚踩稳，只侧弯，不通过后仰或前倾增加幅度。
items.en: Side of the waist and balance: keep the feet planted and avoid leaning forwards or backwards to increase the range.

items.zh: 本动作引发疼痛时停止，不通过增加幅度或负重继续；先向医生或物理治疗师确认。
items.en: Stop if this exercise causes pain; do not add range or load before seeking clinical advice.

items.zh: 已有医嘱限制站立平衡训练、过头伸臂或脊柱侧屈时，先取得许可。
items.en: Obtain clearance first if standing balance work, overhead reaching or spinal side bending has been restricted.

definition.countingSemantics: Timed unilateral stretch of the right side while bending left. The 8-second source demonstrates one slow bend-and-return with an instantaneous peak, not an 8-second hold. Existing 30 seconds is per-side timed work; opposite-side media is not generated.
editorialNotes: root已裁决：本片仅右臂过头、身体向LEFT弯以拉RIGHT侧；startingSide=right指被拉伸侧。peak3.8秒没有停留段，不播成保持8秒。
默认30秒每侧保持，8秒仅是可用的外部换侧提示边界，不强制每loop切侧；本片不含另一侧且不生成镜像素材。
背景办公椅保留在props，但动作不依赖椅子承重，equipment沿旧目录为空。h-banana为去掉站立平衡要求的体侧拉伸替代/降阶候选，非完全等价处方；独立进阶ID未有。
相位来自catalog/v2/batches/b001.json真实秒区间；剂量数字与范围保持旧catalog，rhythm不附旧reps来覆盖默认剂量。
双语注意、通用禁用筛查、协同肌群与关系均已有具体草稿，pending表示未审而非缺数据；协同包含姿势稳定或次要拉伸角色，不作为肌电激活或额外高亮处方。
关系目标为本仓库真实ID候选，但未必已有同模型可发布v2包；不得自动回退弃用模型素材。空关系数组的缺口见逐动作说明。
医学通用筛查与证据边界沿用catalog/v2/definition-evidence.md所列AAOS/NHS一手资料；不编造疾病特异绝对禁忌。所有编辑与医学审核保持pending。
definition.movementSides: This media only bends left to stretch right. The event at 8 seconds is an optional external side-change cue, not a switch encoded in the clip and not a mirrored asset.

switchPoint.semantics: This media only bends left to stretch right. The event at 8 seconds is an optional external side-change cue, not a switch encoded in the clip and not a mirrored asset. Complete the prescribed per-side time before changing sides; the boundary is available, not mandatory every loop.
